payload.title: Durable triggers: drive 'page is live' and 'rating changed' from the change stream; remove the best-effort publish call
payload.description:
Today a publish tells the newsletter and notifications functions with a short best-effort call, and every error is swallowed. That keeps publishing fast and can lose the event; the Announcement's once-only key cannot help if the event never arrives. Make the two facts that start an Announcement durable: "this Story's page is live" and "this Story's rating changed" reach one announcement worker from the change stream of the records that already record them. Delete the best-effort call. Publishing stays fast because it only writes its own record. Which record marks "page live" is chosen in this task.

Design (section 13.3 change A, 13.4): ~/Projects/papyrus-announcement-delivery-design.md. Order: after slice 1 (PPY-3792dd) and slice 2 (PPY-a570e8), before X on the new records (PPY-efd06c). A timer that fires only raises an event; the worker re-reads the record and re-checks everything.

**Acceptance criteria**
- Gherkin: a publish whose first trigger fails is still announced once (the change stream delivers it; the dedupeKey keeps it to one Announcement).
- Gherkin: a rating change reaches the announcement worker from the change stream and re-evaluates eligibility.
- The best-effort publish call to the newsletter and notifications functions is removed, with its swallowed-error path; no fallback or second path remains.
- Publishing latency is unchanged: publish writes only its own record.
- One worker per channel account for every channel (see PPY-a570e8).
- No new inbox table; the change stream, the once-only key and Caducus's queue are the path.

Design: ~/Projects/papyrus-announcement-delivery-design.md. X feed stays OFF. No real email addresses in specs or fixtures. Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs.
